candidates.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Produce one exquisite photorealistic premium studio equipment portrait for the Strength Ledger movement identity DUMBBELL INCLINE BENCH PRESS. Square high-resolution master, ideally 2048 x 2048. ONLY a single mechanically realistic adjustable incline bench and exactly TWO identical unbranded fixed-weight steel dumbbells. No human, hands, body, anatomy, text, logos, brands, numbers, racks or other equipment. Incline back pad at approximately 35 degrees above horizontal, separate short seat pad at a slight uphill angle, plausible hinge and one adjustment ladder/brace connected to a welded graphite steel frame with two stable transverse floor feet. It must unmistakably look like a training incline bench, not furniture. Dumbbells have symmetric matching cylindrical metal heads, short straight knurled handles, precise concentric machining and realistic perspective. Dumbbells must rest visibly on a supporting surface, never float. Graphite/black upholstery with fine grain and seams; neutral gunmetal steel; controlled large soft neutral key light from upper left/front, restrained violet rim light from rear right, tiny subdued magenta bounce if useful. Equipment remains neutral, not painted purple. Near-black seamless studio and rubber training floor with extremely restrained texture, believable soft grounded shadows, no visible horizon, no decorative fog or laser lights. Metal highlights make dumbbells identifiable at 48–72px. All equipment fully inside the central 80–84% of the image with balanced 8–10% crop-safe breathing room. Premium high-end product photography, crisp credible engineering, no generative melting, no neon/cyberpunk, no cartoons. No layouts, labels, borders or collage. Composition A: elevated moderate three-quarter view from the FRONT LEFT, camera about seated chest height, normal 65mm lens character. Bench seat is toward lower-left foreground, head of back pad rises toward upper-right background. The two identical dumbbells lie horizontally on the floor as a clearly matched pair immediately forward and to either side of the seat's front foot, within easy reach of a seated lifter, not under the bench. Show both handles unobstructed and maintain a strong triangular grouping of bench pad and two bright dumbbells. Natural compact studio framing.

refinement: Use case: precise-object-edit. Refine this photorealistic Strength Ledger dumbbell incline bench press equipment portrait into the final high-resolution square master. Target image is the supplied candidate C. KEEP the normal-lens front/side three-quarter perspective, graphite metal, black upholstered pads, two same-size horizontal brushed-steel dumbbells, their crisp knurled handles, neutral key lighting, restrained violet rim, near-black studio background and realistic grounding. No human, text, numbers, logo or anatomy. REQUIRED CORRECTION: this bench currently reads too upright. Lower the back pad to a clearly moderate 30–35-degree INCLINE PRESS position above horizontal, not a 55–70-degree shoulder press chair. Rebuild only the bench support geometry as needed so a single backrest brace visibly and solidly engages ONE notch of the angle-adjustment ladder, with a believable common pivot below the gap between seat and back pads. No floating brace, no disconnected hinges, no extra legs, no impossible intersecting parts. Keep the short seat almost horizontal, slight 5–10-degree anti-slide tilt. Keep the physical dumbbell pair prominent, fully grounded, symmetric and entirely inside the image, with visible handles and no ambiguity about identical size. Preserve their compact side-by-side floor placement beside the front of the bench for a lifter about to sit and press. Reframe to keep every bench foot, both dumbbells and the head of the back pad inside an 8% safe margin, but do not shrink the subject excessively. Preserve light-grey highlights around the pad so its incline silhouette reads at thumbnail size. A quiet dark floor with softer less noisy texture than current. Final production-quality high-resolution master, request 2048x2048 if supported; a single image, no contact sheet or UI.
